newsitem.title: USA: Winn-Dixie Stores referred to FTC - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Winn-Dixie Stores referred to FTC - WSJ.

text.p: The National Advertising Review Board on Friday decided to refer Winn Dixie Stores' comparison-pricing ad policy to the Federal Trade Commission, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
Wal-Mart last summer protested Winn'Dixie's advertising practices, saying they were misleading, the story says.
Wal-Mart said Winn-Dixie - in comparing its prices to those of Wal-Mart - was using Wal-Mart prices that were in some cases several weeks old, the story says.
